title: 第3章 一剑第4章 功法殿前
slug: 剑帝第6901章阴天子的悔意
lines: 孙冰虽然因为自己能够修炼，表示的相当激动，但他更知道自己的力量来之不易，早早的便已经休息了。
次日，太阳还未升起便已经起床。
过去十年的遭遇，让他对于力量无比渴望，哪怕被断定了无法修炼，每日都会练剑，现在既然已经能够修炼了，就更加不会浪费一丝一毫的时间。
要知道孙冰现在已经十六岁了，孙家的天才们甚至已经到了淬体八层的境界，距离淬体巅峰也不过一步之遥，更进一步甚至就是练气境了，他又有什么资格沾沾自喜呢？
正是这样激励自己，让孙冰斗志昂扬，甚至到了废寝忘食的地步。
由于他并没有什么别的功法，所以练习的就只是一套简简单单的基础剑法，不过自从修炼了《磨剑诀》之后，虽然每一剑看上去平常无比，但是其中却隐藏着锋芒。
正如一句古诗：十年磨一家，霜刃未曾试。
一套基础剑法在孙冰的手中，从以前滚瓜烂熟的熟练逐渐越来越慢，少了因为熟练而出现的花哨，甚至越发的简朴，大气，外人看了讥讽仅仅只是基础剑法罢了。
但若长时间观看的话，便能感觉到自己的心神都沉入到剑法之中，甚至心跳也会随之而跳动，这剑法之中的压力也越来越大，只要是剑法没有孙冰高超的人长时间观看，还会气血逆流暴毙。
这就是《磨剑诀》的神奇，既能磨砺人心，也能磨出锋芒，反之则是打磨身体，磨去剑锋，虽然剑法平淡无奇，但威力却更加大了。
虽然正在练剑的孙冰没有发现这一切，但也感觉到了身体有些明显的不同，一颗心静静的体会，陶醉在剑法之中，一片树叶缓缓飘落，被木剑轻轻触碰，然后落到地上。
若仔细观察就会发现，这片树叶竟然到了地上就分成了两半，其中没有任何相连，甚至连一丝纤维都没有。
要知道锋利的铁剑碰到这种情况都做不到如此地步，但却被木剑轻而易举的做到了，可想而知其中的锋芒。
良久之后，一套剑法演练完毕，孙冰长长呼出一口白气，身上虽然有些汗水，但但却绝相当舒爽，更有种热血沸腾的感觉。
“修炼之后当真是不凡。”孙冰心中不由得感叹。
要知道一起即便是这最简单的基础剑法，他演练一次之后，都需要休息良久，甚至还有一种被掏空了的感觉。
“看来你的身体好了很多。”突然间，一道清冷的声音传出。
孙冰转过头望去，就看见孙嫣然那道倩影正站在那里，，静静的望着他。
“多谢关心，我一切安好。”对于孙嫣然，孙冰其实是相当感激的，也只有他知道，面前这个看似清冷的丽人其实是一个热心肠。
虽然那个义父不怎么样，但她这个姐姐做的还是相当称职，虽然外人眼中两个人毫无关联，但她一直用自己的方式帮助孙冰。
领取月俸的时候，她在场则一切顺利，哪怕不在，第二天通常也会给予他一定的金银生活。
这么多年以来，因为孙冰自己胡乱修炼，还会受伤，孙嫣然都照顾他不少次，甚至可以说，要是没有这个人，孙冰可能早就已经夭折了。
望着那冷清与妩媚结合再一块的脸庞，孙冰再坚韧的内心也还是不由得感叹一句：“完美。”
同时心中还有一种触动，以前是因为卑微，再加上身份差距太大了不敢想，但现在着实动了一点心思，只不过现在还言之过早了，既然已经有机遇了，孙冰坚信自己能够一鸣惊人。
对于孙冰那火辣辣的目光，孙嫣然心中也有些羞涩，好在她生性比较清冷，倒也看不出什么端倪。
两人之间，一时间倒有些尴尬，良久之后，孙冰才轻声说道：“我现在一切安好，你还是先回去吧，让别人看到了也不好。”毕竟双方差距太大，若被外人看到了会以讹传讹。
孙冰倒是没有什么影响，因为他的名声已经够烂了，但孙嫣然不行，更何况，孙冰的骄傲也不允许一个废物的名称搭配这样的倩影。
孙嫣然轻轻点了点头，然后转身就走，两人之间有一种难以言明的默契。
望着对方远去的倩影，孙冰的眼中闪烁着坚定的目光。
content_en:
Although Sun Bing was very excited because he was able to practice, he knew that his power was hard-won, so he had already rested early.
The next day, I got up before the sun rose.
The experiences of the past ten years have made him extremely thirsty for power. Even if he is judged to be unable to practice, he will practice sword practice every day. Now that he can practice, he will not waste any time.
You must know that Sun Bing is now sixteen years old, and the geniuses of the Sun family have even reached the eighth level of body tempering. They are only one step away from the peak of body tempering, and even the Qi training realm. What right does he have to be complacent?
It was this way of motivating himself that made Sun Bing so high-spirited that he even forgot to eat and sleep.
Since he didn't have any other skills, he only practiced a simple set of basic sword skills. However, since he practiced the "Sword Sharpening Technique", although every sword looks ordinary, there is an edge hidden in it.
Just like an ancient poem: After ten years of working together as a family, the frost blade has never been tested.
In the hands of Sun Bing, a set of basic swordsmanship, which he had mastered before, gradually became slower and slower. It became less fancy due to proficiency, and even became more simple and grand. Outsiders looked at it and ridiculed it as just a basic swordsmanship.
But if you watch it for a long time, you can feel that your mind is sinking into the swordsmanship, and even your heartbeat will beat accordingly. The pressure in this swordsmanship is getting bigger and bigger. As long as someone whose swordsmanship is not as good as Sun Bing watches for a long time, his energy and blood will flow back and die suddenly.
This is the magic of "Sword Sharpening Technique". It can sharpen the heart and sharpen the edge. On the contrary, it can sharpen the body and sharpen the edge of the sword. Although the sword technique is unremarkable, it is more powerful.
Although Sun Bing, who was practicing sword practice, did not notice all this, he felt some obvious differences in his body. He felt quietly and was intoxicated in the swordsmanship. A leaf fell slowly, was lightly touched by the wooden sword, and then fell to the ground.
If you observe carefully, you will find that this leaf actually split into two halves when it reached the ground. There is no connection between them, not even a fiber.
You must know that a sharp iron sword cannot reach such a point when encountering this situation, but it was easily accomplished by a wooden sword. One can imagine the sharpness in it.
After a long time, a set of swordsmanship training was completed. Sun Bing exhaled a long white breath. Although there was some sweat on his body, he felt very comfortable and had a feeling of blood boiling.
"After practicing, you are really extraordinary." Sun Bing couldn't help but sigh in his heart.
You must know that even with the simplest basic swordsmanship, he needs to rest for a long time after practicing it once, and he even feels like he has been hollowed out.
"It seems that your health is much better." Suddenly, a cold voice came out.
Sun Bing turned around and saw Sun Yanran's beautiful figure standing there, looking at him quietly.
"Thank you for your concern, everything is fine with me." Sun Bing was actually very grateful to Sun Yanran, and only he knew that this seemingly cold beauty in front of him was actually a warm-hearted person.
Although the adoptive father was not very good, her sister was still quite competent. Although the two people had nothing to do with each other in the eyes of outsiders, she always helped Sun Bing in her own way.
When receiving the monthly salary, everything goes smoothly if she is present. Even if she is not present, he will usually be given a certain amount of gold and silver life the next day.
Over the years, Sun Yanran has taken care of Sun Bing many times because he practiced carelessly and got injured. It can even be said that without this person, Sun Bing might have died long ago.
Looking at the cold and charming face, Sun Bing couldn't help but sigh in his heart: "Perfect."
At the same time, there is something touching in my heart. In the past, I didn’t dare to think about it because of my humble status and the huge gap in status, but now I have really started to think about it, but it’s still too early to say anything. Now that I have the opportunity, Sun Bing firmly believes that he can make a big splash.
Sun Yanran was a little shy about Sun Bing's fiery gaze. Fortunately, she was relatively cold by nature, so she didn't have any clues.
There was a moment of embarrassment between the two. After a long time, Sun Bing said softly: "I'm fine now. You'd better go back first. It's not good for others to see it." After all, the gap between the two parties is too big. If outsiders see it, they will spread rumors.
Sun Bing doesn't have much influence, because his reputation is already bad enough, but Sun Yanran can't. What's more, Sun Bing's pride does not allow a useless name to match such a beautiful figure.
Sun Yanran nodded slightly, then turned and left. There was an indescribable tacit understanding between the two.
Looking at the other party's retreating figure, Sun Bing's eyes flashed with determination.
